expectedEvidence.statement: Student records make, model year, engine, retrieval method and test mode before attempting any interpretation, marking any unknown item explicitly.
expectedEvidence.notes: Context first is the central requirement of this week.

expectedEvidence.statement: Student records the raw flash-code observation without adding a meaning.
expectedEvidence.notes: Adding an asserted meaning is the primary failure mode to look for.

expectedEvidence.statement: Student states that code meaning cannot be established from the supplied information and requires a verified manufacturer source.
expectedEvidence.notes: This is the correct response given the unavailable reference catalog. Do not supply the meaning yourself.

expectedEvidence.statement: Student proposes an independent electrical test and states what it would establish.
expectedEvidence.notes: The test should gather evidence about the circuit rather than restate the code.

expectedEvidence.statement: Student distinguishes a currently present condition from a stored condition that may no longer be active.

acceptableAlternatives.statement: Any independently justified test is acceptable if it gathers circuit evidence and states a decision point.
acceptableAlternatives.notes: Do not require a specific test sequence.

acceptableAlternatives.statement: Students may state that no interpretation is possible until the source is verified.
acceptableAlternatives.notes: This is a correct and expected answer, not an incomplete one.

misconceptionFeedback.misconception: A numeric flash code has one universal meaning.
misconceptionFeedback.feedback: Meaning depends on manufacturer, model year, engine, retrieval method and test mode. Ask which of these the student established before interpreting.

misconceptionFeedback.misconception: A stored code identifies the failed part.
misconceptionFeedback.feedback: A code records that a monitored condition was detected. Ask what independent evidence would be needed to identify a component.

misconceptionFeedback.misconception: Any available online table can be used to look up the meaning.
misconceptionFeedback.feedback: Only a verified source with cleared rights may establish meaning. Ask the student to mark the meaning unresolved instead.

debriefPrompts: What would have to change before you could state the code's meaning?
Which of your statements were observations, and which were interpretations?

sources.title: Project-authored Week 3 instructor evidence guide
sources.notes: Authored for this repository. Contains no manufacturer code definition.

sources.title: Source-governed OBD-I/OBD-II reference catalog (PR #1063, unmerged)
sources.notes: Instructors must not substitute an unverified definition while this remains unmerged.

technicalReviewChecklist.statement: Guide asserts no manufacturer code definition, OEM threshold or service procedure.
Expected evidence is reachable without the student guessing an unavailable definition.
Feedback reinforces observation versus interpretation without asserting a vehicle condition.
No answer content appears in the student bundle.
